summary: BStr debug formatting confused a valid UTF-8 replacement character (U+FFFD) with the sentinel for invalid UTF-8, printing its bytes as \xEF\xBF\xBD instead of the literal character. The fix checks the original bytes and formats valid U+FFFD through escape_debug(), preserving byte escapes for invalid UTF-8. The fix adds a detecting assertion to impls::test_debug. Both proposed implementation regions occur exactly once in their respective revisions. No tests were run.
